subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a package postinstall loopback TCP probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as an advisory mitigation for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but install-time network probing, a new env surface, and overlap with the update-CLI warning path are operator-experience choices automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
options.body: Merge this as a warning-only package lifecycle mitigation while leaving the stale-gateway message-loss issue open for a complete recovery decision.

options.title: Require Packaged Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output from a real package update or rollback with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Use One Recovery Layer
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want stale-gateway warnings to live only in update CLI output or runtime recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Advisory
recommendation.body: Merge this as a warning-only package lifecycle mitigation while leaving the stale-gateway message-loss issue open for a complete recovery decision.
